digest.en: India and Egypt have launched a joint working group in Cairo to map out a bilateral trade framework. At the same time a senior Iranian cleric arrived in Sarajevo, signaling Tehran’s push for diplomatic ties in Europe.
digest.hi: इमरान खान ने जेल से जजों को चेतावनी भरा पत्र भेजा है। इसी बीच ईरान ने फ्रांस के साइबर हमलों के लिए इजराइल को ज़िम्मेदार ठहराया।

articles.title: India and Egypt form working group to explore trade deal contours
articles.summary: India and Egypt agreed to form a Joint Working Group. They will explore terms for a Preferential Trade Agreement or Free Trade Agreement. The goal is to boost bilateral trade and improve market access. The two countries have decided to set up a Joint Working Group to explore the Terms of Reference for a PTA or FTA to facilitate stronger bilateral trade, improve access to both markets and promote investment linkages between the two countries.

articles.title: Senior Iranian Cleric Visits Bosnia, As Tehran Cultivates A European Connection
articles.summary: A senior Iranian cleric who briefly assumed supreme leader powers after Khamenei's death visited Sarajevo. He urged European nations to distance themselves from US and Israeli policies toward Tehran. The visit highlights Tehran's effort to cultivate a European diplomatic connection. A senior Iranian cleric who briefly helped exercise the powers of Iran's supreme leader following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has visited Sarajevo, urging European countries to distance themselves from US and Israeli policies toward Tehran.

articles.title: Geopolitics’ midlife crisis
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following revelations of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The scandal wiped out half a trillion dollars in market cap. Nvidia's total decline since October now stands at 1.7 trillion dollars. Last week began with revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had carried out an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. It ended with Huang’s resignation and a cumulative loss of half a trillion dollars in market cap, bringing the total decline since October to $1.7 trillion.

articles.title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss ‘world peace’ at trilateral, says China
articles.summary: China confirmed that Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin will meet in Shenzhen this week. The foreign ministry stated the trilateral talks will cover safeguarding world peace. Beijing did not specify other agenda items for the first meeting of its kind. Beijing stops short of confirming specific agenda items, but many hope world’s three biggest nuclear powers will talk about denuclearisation The meeting of Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen this week will cover topics of “groundbreaking significance” including “safeguarding world peace”, the Chinese foreign ministry has said. The confirmation of Thursday’s first-of-their-kind.

articles.title: With Soaring Prices And Police Crackdowns, Free Time Now Costs Too Much For Tehran's Youth
articles.summary: Tehran's youth face rising costs and police crackdowns on cafes and street gatherings. The economy remains battered by war and fears of renewed fighting. These pressures make socializing increasingly difficult for young people in the capital. With an economy battered by war and fears of renewed fighting, life in Iran’s capital keeps getting tighter. Add a crackdown on the cafes and street gatherings where young people socialize, and Tehran feels like it’s closing in on its youth.

articles.title: Urgent climate finance pleas at COP31 face a non-urgent response
articles.summary: Western governments have deprioritized climate action as US President Trump withdrew international funding. Wars in Ukraine and West Asia have increased inflationary pressures. Security spending now competes with urgent climate finance pleas at COP31. Climate action has slipped down the political agenda for Western governments as U. S. President Donald Trump has withdrawn international funding, while wars in Ukraine and West Asia have added to inflationary ‌pressures and the need to spend on security.

articles.title: At his final ASEAN Summit, Guterres upholds cooperation and action on Myanmar
articles.summary: António Guterres urged stronger cooperation with ASEAN and an end to the Myanmar crisis during his final summit in Manila. The UN Secretary-General addressed regional leaders on Monday, emphasizing the need for collective action to resolve the ongoing humanitarian and political situation in Southeast Asia. UN Secretary-General António Guterres underscored the need for stronger collaboration with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and an end to the crisis in Myanmar, in remarks to regional leaders meeting in the Philippine capital Manila on Monday.

articles.title: Beijing hails ‘groundbreaking significance’ of U.S., China, Russia summit in Shenzhen
articles.summary: Beijing described the upcoming U. S., China, and Russia summit in Shenzhen as having groundbreaking significance. The agenda covers the Ukraine war, West Asia stability, and nuclear arms control. Officials suggest the meeting will be more symbolic than substantive, focusing on high-level diplomatic engagement rather than immediate policy shifts. The meeting is likely to be more symbolic than substantial. U. S. officials have indicated that the agenda is the war in Ukraine, the situation in West Asia, including stabilising global energy supplies, and nuclear arms control.

articles.title: Eurovision organisers criticise Malaysian removal of LGBT+ footage in first Asian contest
articles.summary: Eurovision organizers expressed surprise and disappointment after Malaysian broadcaster TV3 removed LGBTQ+ imagery from the first Eurovision Asia broadcast. The cuts included footage of Thai drag performers and a gay Philippine jury spokesperson. The European Broadcasting Union criticized the alteration of the original program content for the regional audience. Broadcaster TV3 appears to cut footage of Thai drag performers and gay Philippine jury spokespersonEurovision’s organisers have said they are “surprised and disappointed” that the first Eurovision Asia was altered when it was broadcast in Malaysia, apparently removing LGBTQ+ imagery and people from the show. The European Broadcasting Union (EBU), the alliance of public broadcasters that owns Eurovi.

articles.title: Trump to embark on Asia trip in apparent foreign policy push before end of term
articles.summary: Donald Trump is beginning his first overseas trip since the midterm elections, signaling a renewed focus on foreign policy. He plans to meet with Chinese and Russian counterparts during the visit. Analysts suggest the president may prioritize global affairs as his domestic influence wanes following the Republican midterm results. Experts say US president may lean toward global affairs after domestic influence curtailed in midterm electionsDonald Trump is embarking on his first overseas trip since his Republican party’s thumping midterm repudiation by US voters, in what may herald a renewed focus on foreign policy for the remainder of his presidency. The US president will meet his Chinese and Russian counterparts, Xi Jinping.

articles.title: Delaware hit by rare November tornado
articles.summary: An EF1 tornado struck the Salem Woods neighbourhood in Delaware on Thursday, reaching 160 metres wide. The storm traveled 4.4 miles with peak winds of 100 mph. The National Weather Service confirmed the event, noting no injuries were reported despite the severe weather conditions affecting the region. Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms bring hailstones the size of baseballs in ArgentinaThe National Weather Service in the US has confirmed that an EF1 tornado touched down south-east of Newark in the Salem Woods neighbourhood, Delaware, on Thursday.

articles.title: Opinion | Sonia Gandhi, And The Weight Of The Things Left Unsaid
articles.summary: Sonia Gandhi navigates the persistent gap between her actual identity and public perception in India. A recent reflection highlights how decades of political life have forced her to manage the weight of assumptions others hold about her. The tension between reality and reputation remains a defining feature of her public role. "You must know, Sonia beti, that in this country it is not what you are that counts, it is what people think you to be," someone said to Sonia Gandhi when she first arrived in India.

articles.title: ASEAN is more supply-chain battleground than strategic bloc
articles.summary: The 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila highlights a shift from diplomatic rivalry to industrial competition. Washington and Beijing now compete to control critical supply chains for semiconductors, AI, and batteries. This economic contest is reshaping Southeast Asia’s political unity and strategic alignment. Manila’s 49th ASEAN Summit arrives as Southeast Asia’s economic weight grows and its political unity faces a harder test.

articles.title: China’s new missile shield rewrites Indo-Pacific escalation math
articles.summary: China conducted a live-fire missile interception exercise. The People’s Liberation Army demonstrated simultaneous interception of multiple targets. This shift aims to protect mainland leadership and the nuclear arsenal from US and Indian strikes. China’s latest live-fire missile interception exercise highlights a major doctrinal shift as the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) races to protect its mainland leadership, nuclear arsenal and growing aircraft carrier fleet from US precision strikes, Indian submarine-launched nuclear missiles and allied anti-ship networks.

articles.title: Toward a new global AI chip order
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive. The move turned a corporate scandal into a geopolitical crisis. Nvidia’s graphics processing units are critical to the global technology supply chain. Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia’s chief executive has transformed a corporate scandal into an emerging geopolitical crisis for the world’s most valuable technology supply chain. Yet the political consequences may endure long after the personal details.

articles.title: Central Asia's AI Race: Big Ambitions, Even Bigger Risks
articles.summary: Central Asian governments are pursuing AI hub status while critics highlight financing gaps and reliance on fossil fuels. The region faces transparency issues amid long-standing corruption concerns. These structural weaknesses threaten the viability of their digital infrastructure plans. Across Central Asia, governments are racing to become the next global AI hub. Yet critics are flagging shaky financing, over reliance on dirty power, and a lack of transparency in a region long plagued by corruption.

articles.title: Managing risk on Ukraine’s frontline
articles.summary: The top UN official in Ukraine warns that humanitarian workers face heightened risks on the frontline. Aid providers must balance proximity to affected communities with the dangers of active conflict zones. This operational tension complicates the delivery of essential support to vulnerable populations. Humanitarian workers providing support to communities on the frontline of the war between Ukraine and Russia must balance remaining close to those in need with the heightened risks of operating in a conflict zone, according to the top UN official in Ukraine.

articles.title: Empowering faith and Indigenous leaders to combat hate
articles.summary: Speakers at the Muscat Plan of Action Forum in Oman called for greater empowerment of religious and Indigenous leaders. They argued these figures should act as full partners in conflict prevention, not just receive praise. The forum emphasized the need for active collaboration in addressing hate and division. Religious, traditional and Indigenous leaders need to be empowered to act as full partners in preventing conflict, not just praised for their role, speakers said Sunday at the opening of the Muscat Plan of Action Forum in Oman.

articles.title: Barred By The Taliban, Afghan Girls And Women Now Shut Out Of School In Iran And Pakistan Too
articles.summary: Afghan women seeking education in Iran and Pakistan face growing barriers. Restrictive immigration rules, poverty, and local instability are blocking their access to schools. Many students can no longer continue their studies in exile due to these compounding pressures. Many Afghan girls and women have moved to Iran and Pakistan to pursue their education in high schools and universities. But restrictive immigration policies, poverty, and instability in both countries have made it increasingly difficult for them to continue their studies in exile.

articles.title: Bahrain Says It Intercepted Iranian Attacks As Tehran Claims Strike On US Base
articles.summary: Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks on November 15 after explosions and sirens sounded across the kingdom. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the strike targeted a US military installation. Bahraini air defenses destroyed the incoming projectiles during the incident. Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on November 15, after explosions and air raid sirens were reported across the Gulf kingdom and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it had targeted a US military installation.

articles.title: Ukraine Says Starshield Restrictions Persist, Hampering Drone Defenses
articles.summary: Ukraine reports that Starshield restrictions remain widespread. These limits hamper the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered drones near the front line. Moscow gains more opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets as a result. Ukraine says restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones near the front line and giving Moscow additional opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets.

articles.title: One Tehran Street Becomes Battleground Over Personal Freedom
articles.summary: Tehran's Iranshahr Street has become a gathering spot for young Iranians seeking personal freedom. It has also emerged as a flashpoint in a growing confrontation between authorities and Generation Z members. Tehran's Iranshahr Street has become a popular gathering place for young Iranians seeking to express themselves freely. But as Radio Farda's Hannah Kaviani explains, it has also emerged as a flashpoint in a growing confrontation between authorities and members of Iran's Generation Z.

articles.title: Preparing for drought in Central America
articles.summary: Anastacio Martínez Gómez, 73, farms in southwestern Honduras where the Dry Corridor’s unpredictable rains dictate survival. His decades of experience cannot fully offset the region’s intensifying drought cycles. Across Central America, farming families face shrinking yields as seasonal patterns grow erratic. The corridor’s climate volatility now outpaces traditional agricultural knowledge. Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains.

articles.title: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
articles.summary: The Gulf region remains tense nearly nine months after strikes on Iran. Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. Attacks on vessels are increasing in frequency. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the situation. Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge.

articles.title: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
articles.summary: Armed groups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are obstructing Ebola response efforts. They continue attacking civilians and health workers. These disruptions hinder containment measures. UN responders reported the ongoing violence on Friday. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.

articles.title: 'शायद जिंदा न लौट सकूं...', इमरान खान ने जजों से लगाई गुहार, लिखा चेतावनी भरा पत्र
articles.summary: पाकिस्तान के पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री इमरान खान ने जेल से जजों को पत्र भेजा। उन्होंने अपनी जान को खतरा बताया और सही इलाज न मिलने का आरोप लगाया। खान का दावा है कि उनकी दाईं आंख की 85 प्रतिशत रोशनी चली गई है। पाकिस्तान के पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री इमरान खान ने अपनी जान को खतरा बताया है. उन्होंने जेल से इसको लेकर चेतावनी जारी की है.

articles.title: PM मोदी को संस्कृत श्लोक सुनाते दिखे फिलीपींस के बच्चे, प्रधानमंत्री ने शेयर किया वीडियो
articles.summary: फिलीपींस के मनीला में आसियान शिखर सम्मेलन के दौरान पीएम मोदी का स्वागत हुआ। स्थानीय स्कूल के बच्चों ने संस्कृत के पूर्ण कुंभ श्लोक और नारायण सूक्तम का पाठ कर उन्हें अभिवादन किया। प्रधानमंत्री ने इस वीडियो को सोशल मीडिया पर साझा किया। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी फिलीपींस दौरे पर मनीला पहुंचे. जहां उनका भव्य स्वागत किया गया. इस दौरान फिलीपींस के बच्चों ने पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी का संस्कृत के मंत्र बोलकर स्वागत किया.

articles.summary: ईरानी विदेश मंत्री अब्बास अराघची ने कहा कि ईरान पाकिस्तान पर भरोसा करता है। अमेरिका से चल रही बातचीत में पाकिस्तानी मध्यस्थता की कोशिशों का इस्तेमाल किया जा रहा है। दोनों देशों के बीच हालिया हमलों के बाद तनाव बना हुआ है। दोनों देशों में किसी डील पर सहमति नहीं बन पा रही है। पिछले कुछ दिनों में दोनों देशों ने एक-दूसरे के ठिकानों पर फिर हमले किए, जिससे स्थिति और गंभीर हो गई है।

articles.summary: नौसेना प्रमुख एडमिरल कृष्ण स्वामीनाथन ने होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य में जहाजों की तैनाती का कारण बताया। इसका उद्देश्य भारतीय व्यापारिक जहाजों को सुरक्षा प्रदान करना है। जरूरत पड़ने पर इन जहाजों को युद्ध क्षेत्र से सुरक्षित निकाला जाएगा। Indian Navy deployment: नौसेना प्रमुख एडमिरल कृष्ण स्वामीनाथन ने सोमवार को बताया कि भारतीय नौसेना के जहाजों को होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य (Strait of Hormuz) के पास क्यों तैनात किया गया है।

articles.title: मनीला एयरपोर्ट पर पीएम का भव्य स्वागत, लगे भारत माता की जय और मोदी-मोदी के नारे
articles.summary: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन के लिए मनीला पहुंचे। हवाई अड्डे पर भारतीय समुदाय ने उनका जोरदार स्वागत किया। भीड़ ने भारत माता की जय और मोदी के नारे लगाए। यह भव्य استقبال क्षेत्रीय राजनीतिक सहयोग के संदर्भ में देखा गया। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी आसियान-भारत और पूर्वी एशिया शिखर सम्मेलन में हिस्सा लेने फिलीपींस की राजधानी मनीला पहुंच गए हैं.

articles.title: इजराइल में फिर उठी राष्ट्रीय एकता सरकार बनाने की मांग, नेतन्याहू बोले- देश की चुनौतियों से निपटने
articles.summary: कार्यवाहक प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने राष्ट्रीय एकता सरकार बनाने की अपील की है। उनका कहना है कि देश की मौजूदा चुनौतियों का सामना केवल ऐसी सरकार कर सकती है। यशार पार्टी के प्रमुख गादी आइजेनकोट अन्य दलों के साथ गठबंधन की बातचीत कर रहे हैं। राजनीतिक सरगर्मियां तेज हो गई हैं। यरुशलम। कार्यवाहक प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने एक बार फिर राष्ट्रीय एकता सरकार बनाने की अपील की है।

articles.title: होर्मुज स्ट्रेट के पास ईरानी सेना को मिली अमेरिका के खिलाफ कामयाबी, पकड़ा अमेरिकी ड्रोन
articles.summary: ईरान की इस्लामिक रिवोल्यूशनरी गार्ड कॉर्प्स ने होर्मुज स्ट्रेट के पास अमेरिकी ड्रोन पकड़ लिया। यह घटना दोनों देशों के बीच हालिया आपसी हमलों के बाद हुई। तनाव की स्थिति में यह कार्रवाई नया मोड़ मानी जा रही है। हाल ही में दोनों देशों ने एक-बार फिर एक-दूसरे के ठिकानों पर हमले किए। इसी बीच ईरान की आईआरजीसी – इस्लामिक रिवोल्यूशनरी गार्ड कॉर्प्स (IRGC – Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps) को अमेरिका के खिलाफ एक कामयाबी मिली है।

articles.summary: आईबीएम के चेयरमैन और सीईओ ने ट्रंप के दूसरे कार्यकाल में भारत-अमेरिका संबंधों पर सकारात्मक टिप्पणी की। टैरिफ और रूसी तेल की खरीद पर सख्ती ने संबंधों पर असर डाला था। दोनों देशों के बीच ट्रेड डील में देरी जारी है। अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति के तौर पर डोनाल्ड ट्रंप (Donald Trump) के दूसरे कार्यकाल में भारत-अमेरिका संबंधों (India-US Relations) में कुछ हद तक गिरावट देखने को मिली।

articles.summary: ट्रंप प्रशासन चीन की चुनौती का मुकाबला करने के लिए अमेरिकी एआई कंपनियों को नेशनल चैंपियन का दर्जा देने की तैयारी कर रहा है। इस पहल में नवीडिया, माइक्रोसॉफ्ट और ओपनएआई समेत लगभग दो दर्जन कंपनियों को शामिल किया जाएगा। अमेरिकी एआई कंपनियों को देंगे नेशनल चैंपियन का दर्जा, चीन की चुनौती से निपटने की है तैयारी।

articles.summary: फुकेत की एक वाणिज्यिक इमारत में लगी आग में 11 लोगों की मौत हुई। 16 से अधिक लोग जख्मी हुए। आग आसपास की इमारतों में फैल गई। रेस्क्यू कार्य जारी है। Massive Fire in Phuket: थाइलैंड की कॉमर्शियल बिल्डिंग में लगी भयानक आग की वजह से 11 लोगों की मौत हो गई है, जबकि 16 से ज्यादा लोग जख्मी हैं.

articles.title: मिनाब स्कूल हमले को लेकर ईरान ने दो अमरीकी नौसैन्य अधिकारियों को दी धमकी
articles.summary: ईरान ने दो अमेरिकी नौसेना अधिकारियों को मारने की धमकी दी। ईरान का दावा है कि इन दोनों ने मिनाब स्कूल पर हमला किया। उस हमले में 168 बच्चों की मौत हुई थी। ईरान ने दो अमेरिकी नौ सेना के अधिकारियों को जान से मारने की धमकी दी है। ईरान ने कहा है कि दोनों सैन्य अधिकारियों ने मिनाब स्कूल पर बम बरसाए थे।
